انفجروا (form VII)
# اِنْفَجَرُوا (infajarū) /in.fa.d͡ʒa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
# اِنْفَجِرُوا (infajirū) /in.fa.d͡ʒi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْفَجَرَ (infajara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
